spec_lessons: Add a strict completeness check that requires every field to be non-empty and match the expected format for all rows; any row with missing or placeholder values (e.g., 'MISSING') must fail the spec.
build_lessons: When cleaning numeric or string fields, scan for accidental digit duplication (e.g., '2092096.3' → '2096.3') by detecting repeated substrings and applying a rule to keep only the first occurrence if the duplicated part matches a plausible value pattern.

When parsing numeric fields from strings, first remove any non-digit characters except a single decimal point or leading minus sign, then validate the resulting value against plausible ranges (e.g., monthly fees < 100k, seats < 1000) to catch digit duplication or prefix errors like '22794.63' → '2794.63'.
